We are expecting around 500 attendees including senior executives, investors, and tech enthusiasts. The venue must have a dedicated registration area at the entrance and a green room for speakers. We would like the stage setup to include a large LED backdrop displaying the Tech Summit 2026 branding. All presentation equipment (projectors, clickers, mics) should be tested and ready by 7:30 AM. Parking arrangements for at least 200 vehicles must be confirmed in advance. A point of contact from the vendor team should be available on-site throughout the event.
